label: React Router 7, streaming with a Suspense boundary
mechanism: React Router 7 static handler with a loader that returns an unresolved promise, rendered through renderToPipeableStream and piped on onShellReady. The slow region sits behind a Suspense boundary, so the shell is not downstream of the query. This is the tuned configuration.

label: React Router 7, loader awaited before render
mechanism: The same app with the loader awaited and the stream piped on onAllReady. No Suspense boundary. This is the default shape most applications ship.
